screenSummary.playArea: A ring of free-falling test masses stretches and squeezes as a gravitational wave passes. A strain-versus-time plot and real-scale length change are shown.
screenSummary.controlArea: Controls set polarization, visual exaggeration, frequency, playback, and the real strain baseline. Reset All returns to the starting state.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Choose plus or cross polarization, adjust exaggeration, and press play to watch the ring deform.

waves.currentDetails: Polarization {{polarization}}, visual strain {{strain}}, frequency {{frequency}} Hz, real ΔL {{deltaL}} m.

screenSummary.playArea: A Michelson interferometer schematic shows arm motion and output power. A log-log sensitivity chart compares toy noise terms with a real LIGO curve.
screenSummary.controlArea: Controls set arm length, cavities, laser power, noise sources, sky angles, polarization, and playback. Reset All returns to the starting state.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Change arm length or laser power and watch the sensitivity curve, or press Blind spot to null the antenna response.
